title: Sheinbaum flags two-firm concentration of electoral material contracts, says 2027 vote not at risk
detail: At her Oct 30 conference Sheinbaum said two companies have held INE and state electoral-body (OPLE) material contracts for over two decades, and ruled out that the probe endangers the 2027 elections. She also confirmed she will attend a Bellas Artes tribute to Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas, and the conference was announced as suspended on Nov 2 for Day of the Dead (resuming Nov 3).
